name: smwpatches-magikoopa-sprite-hijack
title: Magikoopa Sprite Hijack
description:
This patch hijacks Magikoopa's "turn block into sprite" routine so that you can specify your own sprite numbers for it to generate. (There is a "Sprite kind x 3" bytes table in the patch that holds all possible sprite numbers.) You can also use custom sprites and stunned sprites.

Updated by Isikoro
- Allows you to set the sprites to be produced, level by level, using 1 byte RAM. It can also be shared at all levels.
- Extra bytes can now be set for the custom sprites produced.
- Supported for Monty Mole and Swooper Bat.
